versions.content: Name Func_{Name} Kind ProvidedPort Interface FunctionInhibition Description A client can query the FiM for execution permission for a specific function. The FIDs which represent the functions are not directly used by the client SW-C. Instead, the mechanism of "port-defined argument values" is used and every FID is mapped to a separate port that is responsible for the data exchange via RTE. Type FiM_FunctionIdType Port Defined Argument Value(s) Value {ecuc(FiM/FiMConfigSet/FiMFID/FiMFunctionId.value)} Variation Name = {ecuc(FiM/FiMConfigSet/FiMFID.SHORT-NAME)}
